name: Kusatta Kajitsu
source:
Mifuyu was a bit of a nerd. Since graduating from college she had become a prim and proper woman, but she used to be a cosplay freak.
As her marriage to her sexually unsatisfying fiancee approached, she was reminded of those good times ...
